description: Welcome to 1889 Monticello St. This home is located in the Walnut Hill area and is central to downtown Petersburg, Fort Lee, Amazon, and I95! Outside of this home has a fully fenced in yard with privacy fencing in the back, New roof, newer windows, newer HVAC, fresh paint, and much more. Step inside and you will love the new open floor plan! The kitchen has been opened up to the dinning and living area and has an excellent flow and lots of natural lighting. The floors have also been updated with beautiful plank flooring. The kitchen has been redone with new cabinets, granite countertops, and a new stove. You also have an upstairs that can easily be finished off to include more bedrooms and an additional bathroom! Don't miss out on this opportunity, call your Realtor today for your own private showing!

description: This absolutely stunning colonial home sits on a large corner lot right across from the Gov. Mifflin School. The exterior is all brick  The home has 2 decks in the rear and a nice size back yard with a fire pit and the yard is fenced.  The front of the house is very welcoming  with a full covered porch, great for sitting out and watching the people go by or to have coffee in the morning.  Once you enter the home you will notice the hardwood floors throughout and beautiful stained glass windows.  There is a side entrance to the house which would be great for an in home business and could be separate from  the rest of the house.  Commercial zoning has already been approved.  The home is extremely well maintained and in move in condition.  There are plenty of windows for lots of ambient light and an openness feel that you will appreciate.  The first deck was installed in 2017 and the second deck was installed in 2020.  The Family Room and attic are heated by electric baseboard and the rest if the house is heated by natural gas radiant heat.  The home is also air conditioned  by by 2 zone system installed by the previous owner and was just serviced in 2021. The fireplace is only for decoration . Imagine how you can decorate it.  The home is convenient to major highways 222 and 422.  And is directly across from Governor Mifflin school so the kids can walk to school.

Mifflin School. The exterior is all brick  The home has 2 decks in the rear and a nice size back yard with a fire pit and the yard is fenced.  The front of the house is very welcoming  with a full covered porch, great for sitting out and watching the people go by or to have coffee in the morning.  Once you enter the home you will notice the hardwood floors throughout and beautiful stained glass windows.  There is a side entrance to the house which would be great for an in home business and could be separate from  the rest of the house.  Commercial zoning has already been approved.  The home is extremely well maintained and in move in condition.  There are plenty of windows for lots of ambient light and an openness feel that you will appreciate.  The first deck was installed in 2017 and the second deck was installed in 2020.  The Family Room and attic are heated by electric baseboard and the rest if the house is heated by natural gas radiant heat.  The home is also air conditioned  by by 2 zone system installed by the previous owner and was just serviced in 2021. The fireplace is only for decoration . Imagine how you can decorate it.  The home is convenient to major highways 222 and 422.  And is directly across from Governor Mifflin school so the kids can walk to school.;  bedrooms;  bathrooms

description: Behind these walls, a sanctuary. Through the gate, an enchanted escape in "climate perfect Fernwood" where you can leave the madding crowd behind and revel in your serene space above the clouds. One of only a lucky few Topangan homes ideally situated to take in unobstructed views of both Topanga and Old Topanga Canyons, 607 Sky Line Trl has hosted mindfulness retreats, breath work seminars, and yoga classes atop its ancient sandstone boulders and beneath its heritage oaks and towering pines. Stroll along the brick patios and past the heated saltwater pool as it glints with honeyed tones, ascend the stairs between multiple areas perfect for alfresco dining, and enter the home through its vaulted, sunny atrium. The lower bedroom, with low-VOC French oaks floors and mitered windows capturing the view, is presently set up as a spa-like destination but has an ensuite bath with soaking tub and an ideal setup as the primary. Up the Spanish tile stairs you have French door access to an additional 625 sq. ft. of deck for even more jaw-dropping views, direct access to secure off-street garage parking and laundry, and on to the open concept living/dining areas. The custom Bertazzoni range anchors the space, where you can picture yourself prepping hors d'oeuvres for your guests as they listen to the custom water feature burble in the background. An adjacent flex space, presently set up as a third bedroom with a massive window framing the mature landscaping, adds to the charm and versatility of the floorpan. A second bath with custom tile work, a walk-in shower, and views all its own, then another skylit mini-atrium leads you to the big reveal and your toughest choice: A second contender for the primary suite, with French Doors in two directions, its own access to the rooftop deck, and a fully enclosed "catio" built to the Cougar Conservancy standards, for peace of mind on the days you'll have to leave your fur babies at home. 607 Sky Line Trl also benefits from fully-owned solar and two storage batteries, an EV charging station, a full house water softener, additional dedicated cul-de-sac parking spots, and a pool house/casita ready to meet your satellite work needs, or serve as a meditative space to help you find your bliss. And while you'll feel a world away, you're a mere 5 minutes from Pine Tree Circle and 20 minutes from the Reel Inn on PCH.

combined: City: Topanga; Street Address: 607 Sky Line Trl; Home Type: SINGLE_FAMILY; Description: Behind these walls, a sanctuary. Through the gate, an enchanted escape in "climate perfect Fernwood" where you can leave the madding crowd behind and revel in your serene space above the clouds. One of only a lucky few Topangan homes ideally situated to take in unobstructed views of both Topanga and Old Topanga Canyons, 607 Sky Line Trl has hosted mindfulness retreats, breath work seminars, and yoga classes atop its ancient sandstone boulders and beneath its heritage oaks and towering pines. Stroll along the brick patios and past the heated saltwater pool as it glints with honeyed tones, ascend the stairs between multiple areas perfect for alfresco dining, and enter the home through its vaulted, sunny atrium. The lower bedroom, with low-VOC French oaks floors and mitered windows capturing the view, is presently set up as a spa-like destination but has an ensuite bath with soaking tub and an ideal setup as the primary. Up the Spanish tile stairs you have French door access to an additional 625 sq. ft. of deck for even more jaw-dropping views, direct access to secure off-street garage parking and laundry, and on to the open concept living/dining areas. The custom Bertazzoni range anchors the space, where you can picture yourself prepping hors d'oeuvres for your guests as they listen to the custom water feature burble in the background. An adjacent flex space, presently set up as a third bedroom with a massive window framing the mature landscaping, adds to the charm and versatility of the floorpan. A second bath with custom tile work, a walk-in shower, and views all its own, then another skylit mini-atrium leads you to the big reveal and your toughest choice: A second contender for the primary suite, with French Doors in two directions, its own access to the rooftop deck, and a fully enclosed "catio" built to the Cougar Conservancy standards, for peace of mind on the days you'll have to leave your fur babies at home. 607 Sky Line Trl also benefits from fully-owned solar and two storage batteries, an EV charging station, a full house water softener, additional dedicated cul-de-sac parking spots, and a pool house/casita ready to meet your satellite work needs, or serve as a meditative space to help you find your bliss. And while you'll feel a world away, you're a mere 5 minutes from Pine Tree Circle and 20 minutes from the Reel Inn on PCH.;  bedrooms;  bathrooms

description: Excited to present "Sunnybank", a Stunning Queen Anne Victorian overlooking the Ballardvalle area. Conveniently located within walking distance to the South Elementary School, the train station, Spinner's Pizza Parlor and the local playground. This beautiful home is straight out of a magazine with incredible character and charm complimented perfectly with all the modern amenities, Stained glass windows, built-ins and bookcases, fireplaces, functional pocket doors, window seats and a beautiful staircase combined with a renovated kitchen with farmer's sink, stainless steel appliances and an island, primary en-suite, walk-in closets, and 2nd floor laundry and a 2 car garage to point out a few. This home is an entertainer's dream which any homeowner would proud to show off. This is the perfect property for sitting on the wrap around front porch, grilling on the back deck, or enjoying the shade of the mature tree in the front yard. A one of a kind home that you won't want to miss!

Outside you will find a new 24X30 insulated and heated shop, extra covered vehicle, RV parking and wood storage. description: Highest and best offers by Wednesday 2/7 at 2:00! This classic colonial is set back from the road in a private, serene setting. Featuring hardwood floors throughout both levels, this home has a fantastic layout with lots of living space and great flow. The spacious great room with a soaring ceiling includes a fireplace and a pair of built-in cabinets with a beautiful window seat between. Sliders to the deck make for easy indoor/outdoor living. French doors lead to the kitchen with granite counters, a breakfast bar, and dining area. More formal living space includes the living room with a bow window and the dining room, while a home office offers a private place to work. The upper level houses the primary suite with a large walk-in closet and en-suite bath with double sinks, a jetted tub, and shower. Three more bedrooms share this level, two of which have double closets with closet systems. A full hall bath completes the upper level. The unfinished lower level is walk-out with sliders leading to the patio, and would make for great finished space if more room is desired! The lightly wooded property provides serene views from the back deck. A convenient location close to Treadwell Park with sports fields and a community pool, and also the Fairfield Hill Campus which includes the Newtown Youth Academy, Town Hall, the Community Center, Senior Center, and great walking trails! Quick access to Route 34 and Exit 11 of I-84 makes for an easy commute.

This classic colonial is set back from the road in a private, serene setting. Featuring hardwood floors throughout both levels, this home has a fantastic layout with lots of living space and great flow. The spacious great room with a soaring ceiling includes a fireplace and a pair of built-in cabinets with a beautiful window seat between. Sliders to the deck make for easy indoor/outdoor living. French doors lead to the kitchen with granite counters, a breakfast bar, and dining area. More formal living space includes the living room with a bow window and the dining room, while a home office offers a private place to work. The upper level houses the primary suite with a large walk-in closet and en-suite bath with double sinks, a jetted tub, and shower. Three more bedrooms share this level, two of which have double closets with closet systems. A full hall bath completes the upper level. The unfinished lower level is walk-out with sliders leading to the patio, and would make for great finished space if more room is desired! The lightly wooded property provides serene views from the back deck. A convenient location close to Treadwell Park with sports fields and a community pool, and also the Fairfield Hill Campus which includes the Newtown Youth Academy, Town Hall, the Community Center, Senior Center, and great walking trails! Quick access to Route 34 and Exit 11 of I-84 makes for an easy commute.;  bedrooms;  bathrooms

description: This duplex features a grand 3 bedroom/3 bathroom owner's unit that lives like a single family residence, but has the added bonus of collecting extra income from the front 3 bedroom/2 bathroom rental unit. The owner's unit is privately located at the back of the property. A short flight of stairs brings you to a private courtyard with a calming water feature. Upon entry, you'll notice the high ceilings of the living room, built-in bar area, and formal dining space. There are many windows allowing natural light to pour in, a beautiful ceiling fan, cozy gas burning stove-style heater, and red oak wood floors. Adjacent to the living room is another wonderful living area with den and breakfast area for casual dining. The kitchen boasts a SubZero refrigerator, JennAir cooktop, one-year-old Formica countertops, and hardwood cabinetry. The master suite is impressive with double-height ceilings, walk-in closet, and what you never knew you needed... a Jacuzzi tub right in the master bedroom! The master bath has a dual vanity, spacious shower, and more windows pouring in natural light. On the main level there are two more bedrooms, a full bathroom with dual vanity, and a powder room. Upstairs is a lofted retreat. Do you need space for an office, playroom, yoga space or library? There are TWO separate lifestyle areas to make your own, as well as a HUGE walk-in storage closet and private outdoor patio. Head all the way downstairs to find the laundry room and bonus studio unit with a bathroom, gas and water hookups, and its own private entry. There's an attached 2-car garage, carport, and oversized 1-car garage with workshop area. The front unit is impeccably kept and offers three bedrooms, two bathrooms, and a 1-car garage. This duplex is located in the heart of North Redondo Beach, with access to fantastic schools, parks, shopping restaurants, and a short drive to both the Manhattan and Hermosa Beach Piers. This is simply a terrific property in a fabulous neighborhood.

description: Welcome to the Courtyards at Woodmen Hills West. A small community nestled conveniently off of Woodmen Blvd. Here, you'll have easy access to get to Powers Blvd and you are just a few minutes from your local grocery stores and a variety of food options. You also have access to TWO community centers with amenities. Now, the home itself has been well maintained with it just being built in 2018. The backyard is low maintenance with turf installed and is very private with the 6ft privacy fence at the rear and open space beyond that. Coming through the front door, you land right on your very durable LVP flooring and immediately to your left is your powder room. Heading straight back from the front door, you're led to the main living space. Tons of natural light floods this space through the windows and slider leading to the backyard. The family room has a real nice cozy vibe with the carpet below and the moody custom light fixture above. Just behind the family room lies the kitchen - Very modern tones, here, with the dark cabinets and bright white quartz countertops. Ample amounts of cabinet space here and you have a full pantry as well. Just off of the kitchen is your dining nook with plenty of space for a big table to enjoy your meals. Upgraded lighting above the table accents this space well and meshes well with the family room lighting. Heading up the stairs, immediately to your right, is your oversized laundry room. Washer and Dryer are indeed staying with the home. All 3 bedrooms are located upstairs. You have 2 spacious secondary bedrooms with generous closet space. Both bedrooms are linked with a bathroom making this a nice Jack & Jill combo. Lastly, the Primary bedroom, a true oasis for the owners. The lighting above adds some customization to this room. There's plenty of space to add chairs or even a small couch. The en-suite primary bathroom features an expanded tub and shower combo and a walk in closet. Come check out this home in person and be amazed!

A small community nestled conveniently off of Woodmen Blvd. Here, you'll have easy access to get to Powers Blvd and you are just a few minutes from your local grocery stores and a variety of food options. You also have access to TWO community centers with amenities. Now, the home itself has been well maintained with it just being built in 2018. The backyard is low maintenance with turf installed and is very private with the 6ft privacy fence at the rear and open space beyond that. Coming through the front door, you land right on your very durable LVP flooring and immediately to your left is your powder room. Heading straight back from the front door, you're led to the main living space. Tons of natural light floods this space through the windows and slider leading to the backyard. The family room has a real nice cozy vibe with the carpet below and the moody custom light fixture above. Just behind the family room lies the kitchen - Very modern tones, here, with the dark cabinets and bright white quartz countertops. Ample amounts of cabinet space here and you have a full pantry as well. Just off of the kitchen is your dining nook with plenty of space for a big table to enjoy your meals. Upgraded lighting above the table accents this space well and meshes well with the family room lighting. Heading up the stairs, immediately to your right, is your oversized laundry room. Washer and Dryer are indeed staying with the home. All 3 bedrooms are located upstairs. You have 2 spacious secondary bedrooms with generous closet space. Both bedrooms are linked with a bathroom making this a nice Jack & Jill combo. Lastly, the Primary bedroom, a true oasis for the owners. The lighting above adds some customization to this room. There's plenty of space to add chairs or even a small couch. The en-suite primary bathroom features an expanded tub and shower combo and a walk in closet. Come check out this home in person and be amazed!;  bedrooms;  bathrooms

description: Welcome to your dream home ~ all of the work has been done! Nestled on 2 acres along a private road, this spacious craftsman residence offers the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and tranquility. As you step inside, you'll be greeted by a stunning open great room layout, featuring a stone fireplace and a wall of windows that overlook the private backyard. The gourmet kitchen is a chef's delight, boasting a quartz island, double ovens, eating area and a convenient butler's pantry leading to the formal dining room. Ideal for entertaining guests! The primary suite is on the main floor, complete with a spacious walk-in closet & ensuite bathroom that includes both a soaking tub and walk-in shower. You will also find a versatile office or den on the main floor. Upstairs, discover 3 additional bedrooms (2 of them include walk-in closets). Complete laundry room upstairs in addition to washer/dryer hookups in the mudroom on the main floor. Plenty of easily accessible storage...the massive crawlspace is tall enough to stand up in in and has an exterior door entrance. Outdoor living is a delight with 2 decks overlooking the peaceful grounds, perfect for al fresco dining or simply relaxing. The upper deck is covered and the lower deck is complete with a remote awning for shade. Easy exterior covered storage under the decks for your lawnmower or toys. Landscaped yard, sprinkler system, 17kW backup generator & 3-car garage contribute to convenience. Don't miss the opportunity to make this exceptional property your own oasis in Oregon City.
